blocks.text: “Celeste Unscripted” saved the truth for last. In its season finale, the docuseries revealed in a single hour what its cameras had been holding all along: Celeste Cortesi became pregnant during filming; Jonathan Sterling planned to propose on a private island in Palawan; and instead of an engagement, the trip ended the relationship. The two are now separated — and are parents to a son, Sergio, named for Cortesi’s late father. “Well, we’re broken up right now,” Cortesi says in the pair’s final interview for the show. “We just have to prioritize our baby.
